topic: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres: Visualizing Conic Sections
target_audience: High school geometry students or early undergraduates

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Cone and the Plane
lecture_lines: Conic sections result from plane-cone intersections.
Imagine a flashlight creating shapes on a wall.
The intersection angle determines the specific shape.
animations: Fade in a wireframe double-napped cone in #FFFFFF.
Fade in a transparent cutting plane intersecting the cone at an angle, using to highlight the intersection point.
Highlight the resulting ellipse intersection curve in #FF00FF.

sections.title: Introducing Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: Place a sphere inside the cone.
Make it tangent to the cone surface.
Make it tangent to the cutting plane.
animations: Fade in two inside the, tangent to the inner walls.
Translate the cutting plane until it touches both.
Add small points of color #00FFFF at the exact contact points on the plane.
Label the points as Foci in #FFFF00.
Pause briefly to emphasize the static geometry setup.

sections.title: The Geometry of Proof (Focus: Ellipse)
lecture_lines: Each touches the plane at a focus.
Points on the ellipse follow distance rules.
Distances to foci sum to a constant.
animations: Draw a point P moving slowly along the ellipse perimeter.
Draw two line segments from P to the contact point foci.
Display the sum of lengths as a text label near P in #FFFF00.
Maintain the length sum constant as P orbits the ellipse.
Flash the foci in #00FFFF to emphasize their role.

sections.title: Expanding to Parabola and Hyperbola
lecture_lines: Change the plane angle to shift shapes.
Parabolas use one sphere tangent to plane.
Hyperbolas require spheres in both cones.
animations: Adjust the cutting plane angle until parallel to a slant edge of the.
Remove one, keeping only the sphere tangent to the new parabolic cut.
Rotate the to reveal the hyperbola, adding a second sphere in the opposite nappe.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Now you visualize conic sections clearly.
animations: Rotate the whole setup containing the to provide a clear 3D perspective.
Animate the cutting smoothly cycling through all conic angles.
Sync the to shrink or grow while maintaining tangency.
